request_summary: Rerun the GEC suite on DEV using the table endpoint URL for this run only, then restore the configuration.

actions.description: Applied the human-approved temporary override of the DEV table endpoint, prepared delegation manifests, and delegated the rerun to QA-runner under the same approved plan with a new run id.
After the run, reverted the override by hand and confirmed that the dev.yaml diff contains only the timeout change.
Checked the runner result against the console log summary lines.

outcome.detail: The run completed with 51 of 52 scenarios passing; the known gec_002_09 failure remains and the configuration was restored; issuer teardown is unverified.

notes: The backup of dev.yaml was taken in parallel with the edit and already contained the override, so the revert was done manually from the known original line.

friction.description: Backup and edit of the same file were issued in one parallel batch, so the backup captured the edited content; the original line was restored from the earlier diff instead.
